## COMPARISON EVIDENCE

### EVIDENCE

- [filings/bodies/5a239384189d0666.txt] "revenue increasing by 10.3% to £1,608.0 million and underlying operating profit growing by 14.9% to £117.9 million" — H1 2026 trading momentum vs prior year  
- [filings/bodies/5a239384189d0666.txt] "The company's net debt significantly decreased by 74.1% to £15.9 million, and a record order book of £1.9 billion" — Balance sheet and backlog entering H2 2026  
- [filings/bodies/7971cc4e54f0af7f.txt] "revenue and underlying operating profit for the full year will be materially ahead of current market consensus" — July 2026 guidance upgrade  
- [filings/bodies/ch_02442580_MzUyMzYyMjA2OWFkaXF6a2N4.txt] "Free cash flow £175.9m -9%" — FY2025 filing free cash flow (Keller adjusted measure; screen uses £168m statutory/Yahoo FY2025)  
- [filings/bodies/ch_02442580_MzUyMzYyMjA2OWFkaXF6a2N4.txt] "Dividend 70.4p +42%" — FY2025 total dividend; supports dividend-family screen with strong FCF cover (no interim cut flagged)  
- [filings/bodies/63e24814661003ff.txt] "market risks like a downturn in construction markets" — Principal risk from FY2025 annual report  
- [filings/bodies/b4077d9a8b681947.txt] "net debt/EBITDA leverage ratio at the first half of 2026 is expected to be similar to the prior half year (2025 HY: 0.2x), well below the Group's 0.5x-1.5x target range" — Leverage within policy despite buybacks and higher payout  

**Screen reconciliation (FY2025 / H1 2026):** Filing adjusted FCF £175.9m (FY2025 CH) vs screen canonical £168m (Yahoo FY2025 operating cash less capex); TTM FCF £172.4m in snapshot is H1-weighted, not full-year filing. Statutory basic EPS growth ~2.5% (filings) vs `earnings_growth_screen_ttm_pct` 23.7% (TTM/Yahoo-adjusted path)—Lynch/neff models still fail. Yield 2.8% passes dividend-growth family but not high-yield (>3%). `adjusted_signal` remains **buy** (same as raw); no post-review overlay downgrade.

### THESIS BREAKS

- FY filing shows covenant net debt/underlying EBITDA persistently above the 1.5× top of management’s target range, without a credible deleveraging plan.  
- Order book falls materially below £1bn with management citing weaker construction end-markets in a trading update or interim.  
- Full-year filing free cash flow fails to cover dividends (cover below 1.0× on the Group’s adjusted free-cash-flow definition).  
- Confirmed material downturn in North American foundations volumes reversing H1 2026 growth, with statutory profit warning.
